description: Within-cohort rank sum of occupancy_max = max_t Cu/(Cu+Ki_t) over each liability's pre-specified receptors and the fraction of SIDER-positive drugs among the k nearest P35-train drugs in full-panel -log10(Ki) space (Euclidean, ties by INN, a drug never its own neighbour). Equal weights.
fingerprint_floor_note: -log10(100000 nM): chain_benchmark's inactivity convention for the 1-NN baseline, reused so candidate and baseline share one fingerprint
missing_view_rule: no Cmax,u or no fingerprint: no score; never imputed
fitted_on: P35-train drugs (sha256(inn) % 10 not in {0,1}) with a SIDER record and a measured Ki in the panel; labels from sider/labels_train.json (P35.2)
